Originally built in 1865 by Abraham Euler-Brunner, the property has been owned by the Manz family since 1981 and is known for its enduring quality and service standards. The hotel offers 66 rooms, including 6 junior suites, designed for comfort and convenience. As well as Large Meeting Rooms possibilties for your Meetings, Banquets Events. All rooms feature air conditioning, a laptop-size safe, minibar, direct-dial telephone, WLAN, and flat-screen TV, providing a modern guest experience in a classic setting. Applicants can expect to work in a well-established, centrally located hotel that serves both business and leisure travelers. For our three centrally located hotels in Basel (Grand Hotel Euler Basel, Hotel Metropol Basel & Hotel City-Inn Basel), we are looking for a motivated and sales-driven personality who enjoys developing existing client relationships while actively acquiring new business partners for our properties. As Sales Executive , you will play an important role in our commercial development and professionally represent our three hotels within the Basel and Swiss corporate market. Your Responsibilities • Actively acquire new clients, with a strong focus on corporate and business accounts • Manage and further develop existing Corporate Accounts and Key Accounts • Plan and conduct sales calls, client visits and site inspections • Consistently follow up on leads, proposals and business opportunities • Identify new companies, projects and business opportunities within the Basel market • Actively develop cross-selling opportunities across our three hotels • Build and maintain a strong local and regional business network • Use LinkedIn, social media and digital channels for client acquisition and lead generation • Participate in client events, networking events and selected sales activities • Work closely with the General Manager, Revenue Management and operational teams Your Profile You are a confident and communicative professional with an entrepreneurial mindset, a strong sales orientation and a genuine passion for acquiring new business. You will benefit from a high level of responsibility and the freedom to develop new clients, expand business networks, introduce new sales approaches and bring your own ideas into the organisation. Have we sparked your interest, and does your profile match our requirements? If you have not heard from us within four weeks, unfortunately your application has not been selected for the next stage of the recruitment process. Thank you for your interest in our hotels and for the trust you place in us.
